newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Soros El-Rov stake grows to 15.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Soros El-Rov stake grows to 15.2 pct.

text.p: Quantum Industrial Holdings, which is controlled by U.S. investor George Soros, has raised its stake by 0.8 percent in El-Rov (Israel) Ltd, bringing Soros' total holdings to 15.2 percent, El-Rov said on Tuesday.
El-Rov said the 100,000 shares were acquired outside the bourse at 22 shekels each for a total of 2.2 million shekels.
The holding is divided between two Soros funds -- Quantum, which now holds 7.8 percent, and Dolphin Ltd, which has 7.4 percent in the property development and management concern.
Both funds became major shareholders under Israeli regulations last December when their individual holdings began to exceed five percent.
Soros is the second-largest shareholder in El-Rov after Alfred Akirov, who holds some 70 percent of the shares.
